regime_context: The detector shows a narrow eligible leadership (4 of 17 themes eligible), with Energy (H-shares) narrowly atop a mean-reverting Banks/HK ex-HK complex. Rotation breadth is thin (0.24) and absorption is 0.45, so this is a shallow, split leadership rather than a dominant one-narrative regime. Momentum rank itself carries no predictive edge; the absolute-trend gate is the only validated leg. Note that only two themes are scorable (both have 3033.HK as a shared, imperfect tech proxy), so most of this note is judgement rather than gradeable signal.
emerging_watch: Watch whether the narrow 0.24 rotation breadth widens beyond 0.4 and whether absorption crosses above 0.55: that would be the first sign the current Energy/Banks split is getting real sponsorship rather than drifting. If breadth stays under 0.3 for another 10 trading days, the watch retires and the read is a flat, leaderless regime.

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy leads on score and is eligible under the absolute-trend gate; its trend health (Hurst 'trend', durability 0.71) is the strongest among leaders. Crowding is low (z 0.27), so the only validated drawdown-control leg does not force a down-size. The lean is directional on the theme's ability to retain leadership, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Energy is a value/cyclical H-share theme and this leadership is narrow; the challenger Banks complex has a mean-reverting tag, and a shallow rotation usually fails to persist even when the leader is not crowded.

falsifier.text: Energy (H-shares) loses the rank-1 position to Banks (H + HK) for 5 consecutive trading days before the check-by date

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks is eligible and challenger (score 1.213), but its trend health is weaker (Hurst 'mean-revert', durability 0.55) compared to the Energy leader. The absolute-trend gate is the only leg with a forward drawdown edge, and a mean-reverting challenger in a narrow rotation is the classic configuration where the gate says de-risk. This is not a fade on crowding; it is a size-down on trend-health.
theses.dissent: If the H-share financial sector gets a genuine policy/credit cycle tailwind, Banks could hand off cleanly and the mean-revert tag simply means the move is young, not weak.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) overtakes Energy on score and holds rank 1 for 5 consecutive trading days before the check-by date

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: High-Dividend Blue Chips has the highest durability (0.72) and breadth (0.75) of any theme, is eligible, and ranks third. Its crowding is minimal (z 0.13). The staying-power leg is the strongest argument; the trend gate does not currently cap it. A defensive income complex with high breadth is a reasonable directional lean under vol-aware discipline.
theses.dissent: Its 'mixed' Hurst tag means the trend is not cleanly persistent; a defensive income theme can fade quietly without ever becoming a leader, producing drift rather than drawdown.

falsifier.text: High-Dividend Blue Chips drops below rank 5 for 5 consecutive trading days before the check-by date

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable
